## Tests

- [ ] `pnpm run lint`
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm run knip`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] `pnpm run check:bundle`
- [ ] `pnpm run test:e2e`, when the change touches the main process, the IPC contract or a covered
      flow

## Before you ask for a review

- Add a screenshot or a short recording for a change a user can see.
- Add user-facing text to every dictionary in `packages/i18n/src/locales/`.
- Update `AGENTS.md` when a convention changed, and `docs/` when behaviour is described there.
